data.title: 夏洛特 · 窗前微风中的蜜桃真丝睡裙
data.description: 静谧的夏夜微风轻拂卧室白纱窗帘。夏洛特身穿一袭轻柔贴身的蜜桃粉真丝细吊带睡裙坐在窗台软垫上，金黄色的长发松散垂在光滑雪白的香肩上。月光如水洒在她泛红的脸颊与精致锁骨间，少女双手轻轻交握在膝上，碧蓝美眸倒映着月华，神情极尽温柔与恋慕。
data.action: sitting on cushioned window seat in moonlight, peach silk camisole slip dress, blonde hair loose over bare shoulders, delicate collarbone, blushing tenderly looking at viewer
data.location: cozy bedroom window seat with blowing sheer curtains under night sky
data.lighting: silver moonlight illuminating sheer silk fabric and soft blonde locks
data.mood: poetic nocturnal romance, tender vulnerable first love
data.promptProse: Sitting on a cushioned window seat in soft moonlight, Charlotte wears a delicate peach silk camisole. The night breeze plays with sheer curtains and her golden hair as she looks forward with an innocent, loving blush.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte sitting by a moonlit window in a peach silk camisole, smiling with a tender blush.
